CM Fadnavis Expresses Confidence in Mahayuti's Electoral Prospects

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has expressed confidence that the Mahayuti alliance will win all five seats in the upcoming Maharashtra Legislative elections. Separately, he inaugurated EIM's electric truck facility, which has an annual production capacity of 5,000 vehicles.
